subject: Quotes and job tracking at Flex
body:
Hi Flex Cabinets team,

Twenty years of custom kitchens in Calgary means a lot of measurements, quotes and revisions moving through the shop at once. Quick question: how do you keep track of where each job is between quote, approval, build and install?

I'm Aldo — I run Arctos, a small Calgary studio that builds intake forms, job tracking and reporting around how a shop already works. Recently: a case-intake website for True North Kromes, a dental lab that 3D-prints cobalt-chrome frameworks, so labs can submit work directly instead of by phone and email.

If quoting or job tracking eats more of your week than it should, I'm happy to look at how it runs today and tell you honestly whether anything is worth changing. No cost for that look.

—
